counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 1/30 to 0.001 with all else identical; finer integration resolves the close fast encounter so energy is conserved

explanation: Light body falls toward 20x heavier body, reaching separation ~0.37 (near softening 0.3) and speed ~17-18 by step 4. Even with 32-42 substeps, the fixed outer dt=1/30 leapfrog step cannot resolve the sharp high-acceleration pericenter, so total energy drifts ~12 (allowed ~11.5) by step 5. Reducing only dt to 0.001 removes the violation, confirming under-resolved close encounter / too-large timestep as cause.
vision_note: The small blue body rapidly falls toward the much larger blue body, with their separation shrinking to near-contact by step 4. By step 5 the two bodies overlap and the small body whips closely around the larger one.
